input.source: gold.fct_prediction left join gold.fct_player_game on (player_id, game_id), run_kind = 'replay'

in_sample_note: Thresholds and bands were chosen on the 2025-26 replay rows they are evaluated on; the hit rates are in-sample. The coverage curve is published so any other threshold can be read off; the next untouched season is the out-of-sample test.

definitions.edge: prediction - baseline_last10, both from the slate row scored before tip-off
definitions.call: over if edge > threshold; under if edge < -threshold; else no_call
definitions.outcome: hit if actual is on the called side of baseline_last10; miss if on the other; push if actual == baseline_last10 (excluded from hit_rate)
definitions.hit_rate: n_hit / (n_hit + n_miss) over the rows the model called
definitions.coverage: n_called / n, the share of the population's rows the policy calls
definitions.season_mean_sign: over if season_mean - baseline_last10 > 0, under if < 0; scored on exactly the n_resolved rows the model resolved (n == n_resolved): a tie (season_mean == baseline_last10, n_tie) or a missing season mean (season debut, n_missing) has no side and is scored as a coin flip, 0.5; hit_rate = (n_hit + 0.5 * (n_tie + n_missing)) / n. own_threshold_*: the same sign as a policy with the same threshold applied to its own edge, on its own rows (its own n_called)
definitions.season_mean: the player's mean of the stat over earlier games of the same season (the feature module's <stat>_mean_season, recomputed in gold.fct_player_game)
definitions.threshold_selection: largest grid threshold with coverage >= min_coverage, chosen on these rows (in-sample)
definitions.bands: quantiles of actual - prediction on these rows (in-sample); band_50 = q25..q75, band_80 = q10..q90 around the prediction

min10.description: the training population: replayed rows with a box score, at least 10 minutes and both baselines defined
